--dns-brute.help: Perform a DNS brute force on the domain.

--dns-lookup.help: Enable DNS server lookup, default False.

--dns-resolve.help: Perform DNS resolution on subdomains with a resolver list or passed in resolvers, default False.

--dns-server.help: DNS server to use for lookup.

--dns-tld.help: Perform a DNS TLD expansion discovery, default False.

--domain.help: Company name or domain to search.

--filename.help: Save the results to an XML and JSON file.

--google-dork.help: Use Google Dorks for Google search.

--help.help: show this help message and exit

--host.help: IP address to listen on default is 127.0.0.1

--limit.help: Limit the number of search results, default=500.

--log-level.help: Set logging level, default is info but [critical|error|warning|info|debug|trace] can be set

--port.help: Port to bind the web server to, default is 5000

--proxies.help: Use proxies for requests, enter proxies in proxies.yaml.

--quiet.help: Suppress missing API key warnings and reading the api-keys file.

--rate-limit.help: Set API rate limit (e.g., "10/minute", "100/hour"), default is 5/minute

--reload.help: Enable automatic reload used during development of the api

--screenshot.help: Take screenshots of resolved domains specify output directory: --screenshot output_directory
